en.headline: Property sales fall 28.8% in July from previous month
en.dek: The Land Registry recorded 6,715 sale and purchase agreements for all building units last month, with residential agreements down 41.7% to 4,462.
body: The number of sale and purchase agreements for all building units received by the Land Registry for registration in July fell 28.8 per cent from June to 6,715, and was down 6.9 per cent from a year earlier, the government said.

Total consideration for building-unit agreements dropped 37.5 per cent month-on-month to HK$51.7 billion, a 5.3 per cent year-on-year decline. Residential agreements numbered 4,462, down 41.7 per cent from the previous month and 22.6 per cent from a year ago, with consideration of HK$41.9 billion, down 44.6 per cent month-on-month and 9.6 per cent year-on-year.
There were 1,466,737 land register searches in July. The figures reflect a cooling in transaction activity after stronger months earlier in the year.

zh.headline: 7月物業買賣合約按月跌28.8%
zh.dek: 土地註冊處錄得6,715份所有樓宇單位買賣合約，住宅單位合約跌41.7%至4,462份。
body: 政府公布，土地註冊處7月接獲登記的所有樓宇單位買賣合約共6,715份，較6月減少28.8%，按年亦跌6.9%。
樓宇單位買賣合約總代價按月跌37.5%至517億元，按年跌5.3%。住宅單位合約有4,462份，按月跌41.7%，按年跌22.6%；代價419億元，按月跌44.6%，按年跌9.6%。
7月土地登記冊查冊次數為1,466,737次。數字反映年內較早前交投較旺之後，交易活動有所回落。
